name: japan-anime-figure-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server exposing Japanese anime figure price comparison data from MyFigureList and other sources. Three tools: current price, price history, and lowest price search.
long_description: Exposes the accumulated kensho Japan anime figure price dataset (normalized from MyFigureList and other sources) as three read-only MCP tools: figure_current_price (latest price snapshot), figure_price_history (time series), and figure_lowest_price (cheapest available across shops). Pure local data, zero dependencies beyond fastmcp. Ideal for AI agents researching Japanese figure market prices and availability.

tools.name: figure_current_price
tools.description: Current price snapshot for an anime figure in the Japan dataset.

name.description: figure name, series, character, or URL substring.

tools.name: figure_price_history
tools.description: Price time series for an anime figure in the Japan dataset.

limit.description: max number of history rows to return (default 50).

tools.name: figure_lowest_price
tools.description: Cheapest available price for an anime figure across all shops.
